name: image-reveal
description: An image generation canvas where a soft, blurred preview built from the image's own downsampled colors sharpens behind a fine latent-noise layer as the sampler steps, then a tiled VAE-style decode snaps the crisp image in over the frozen last frame, finished by one soft light sheen. Ships a translucent progress pill (spinner + Denoising + n / 30 with tabular numerals), a calm queued state with a 2.6s seam-free shimmer, an error state with optional Retry, seeded per-step noise so batch tiles differ, reduced-motion fallbacks, and auto-simulation mode with staggered queue, hold and loop for grids.
